moved.sentence: Use Google Play Services' Nearby Connections API or Chrome's cross-device features for continuity between Android devices.

judged.note: android-use-nearby-or-chrome-continuity keeps Nearby Connections or Chrome cross-device features for Android-to-Android continuity, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: For Android-to-web continuity, use Firebase Dynamic Links or deep links that resolve in both native and web contexts.

judged.note: android-use-links-that-resolve-natively-and-on-web keeps Firebase Dynamic Links or dual-context deep links for Android-to-web continuity, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Support clipboard sync through Google account integration.

judged.note: android-support-clipboard-sync keeps clipboard sync through Google account integration on Android, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use `NSUserActivity` to advertise the current activity.

judged.note: apple-advertise-with-nsuseractivity keeps NSUserActivity to advertise the current activity on Apple platforms, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Set `isEligibleForHandoff = true` and populate `userInfo` with state needed to restore context.

judged.note: apple-enable-handoff-and-populate-userinfo keeps isEligibleForHandoff = true and populating userInfo with restore state, at SHOULD.
apple-implement-continue-on-receiver keeps implementing application(_:continue:) on the receiving device, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Support Universal Clipboard for cross-device copy/paste.

judged.note: apple-support-universal-clipboard keeps Universal Clipboard for cross-device copy/paste on Apple platforms, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Capture enough state to reconstruct the user's context on the receiving device

judged.note: capture-enough-state keeps capturing enough state to reconstruct the user's context on the receiver, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Continuity MUST feel instant — pre-transfer the minimum viable state, fetch details on arrival

judged.note: continuity-must-feel-instant keeps the MUST and the pre-transfer-minimum, fetch-on-arrival method.

moved.sentence: Fall back gracefully when the receiving device lacks a feature the originating device had

judged.note: fall-back-gracefully keeps graceful fallback when the receiver lacks a feature the originator had, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use deep links as the universal handoff payload — every platform can resolve a URL

judged.note: use-deep-links-as-payload keeps deep links as the universal handoff payload and the every-platform-resolves-a-URL reason, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use shared URLs as the primary continuity mechanism — a well-constructed URL with state parameters is the most universal handoff format.

judged.note: web-use-shared-urls keeps shared URLs as the primary web continuity mechanism and the most-universal-format reason, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Support the Credential Management API for seamless sign-in across devices.

judged.note: web-support-credential-management keeps the Credential Management API for seamless cross-device sign-in, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Consider WebSocket or server-sent events for real-time state sync between active sessions.

judged.note: web-consider-realtime-sync keeps considering WebSocket or server-sent events for real-time sync between active sessions, at SHOULD (no weaker than 'consider').
